verdict.rationale: Notte lets you script deterministic parts and generate/edit workflow code (notte-docs-2, notte-docs-26, notte-docs-30, notte-gh-2), which implies some cached/generated code can be replayed without re-prompting the LLM, but there is no explicit documentation of an action/result cache, deterministic replay guarantee, or cost/latency comparison for repeat runs. missing for 10: explicit caching mechanism for resolved actions, documentation of deterministic replay across runs, and cost/latency benchmarks comparing cached vs re-prompted execution.
